tbdr_architecture.subsystem: Tile-Based Deferred Rendering (TBDR) & Scene Allocation Engine
tbdr_architecture.tiling_mode: Split-Pass Deferred Rasterization with Hardware Tile Acceleration

micro_tile.usage: Fine rasterization, fragment shading, 2x/4x MSAA resolve, MRT color blending

macro_tile.usage: Coarse bounding-box primitive binning, screen-space subdivision, 4K render targets

max_hardware_tile_size.usage: Maximum coprocessor tile buffer allocation in MSR25 hardware

depth_stencil_attachment.residency: 100% on-chip USC SRAM throughout rasterization pass
depth_stencil_attachment.dram_traffic: Zero external DRAM round-trips for intermediate depth/stencil evaluations

hidden_surface_removal.engine: Image Synthesis Processor (ISP) Early-Z / Coarse-Z Unit
hidden_surface_removal.mechanism: Pre-fragment depth testing against on-chip Z-buffer before shader invocation
hidden_surface_removal.overdraw_elimination: 100% for opaque geometry; non-occluded fragment scheduling only
hidden_surface_removal.fragment_kill_penalty: Zero shader cycles wasted on occluded fragments

scene_allocator_pipeline.subsystem_name: Parameter Scene Allocator (MList, MTileArray, VHeap Table)

execution_stages.name: Vertex Transformation & Tiling Pass (TA Pass)
execution_stages.operation: USC executes vertex/meshlet shaders and passes transformed primitives to Tile Accelerator

execution_stages.name: Coarse Bounding Box Evaluation & Binning
execution_stages.operation: TA calculates screen-space bounding boxes and projects primitives onto macro-tile grid

execution_stages.name: MList Node Allocation & Linking
execution_stages.operation: TA writes primitive packets into chunked linked lists indexed per tile in MTileArray

execution_stages.name: Deferred Pixel Rasterization (PDM Pass)
execution_stages.operation: USC fetches binned primitive streams per tile from MTileArray/MList and rasters on-chip

mlist.name: Macro-tile Primitive List (MList)
mlist.description: Dynamic singly-linked list of parameter buffer chunks storing vertex pointers and primitive packets

fields.name: next_chunk_gpu_va
fields.desc: GPU virtual address of next MList chunk (0 if tail)

fields.name: primitive_count
fields.desc: Number of primitives packed in this chunk (max 256)

node_structure.payload_format: Array of 32-bit vertex indices and 64-bit parameter pointers

mtilearray.name: Macro-tile Array (MTileArray)
mtilearray.description: 2D screen-space tile descriptor grid referencing head and tail pointers of MList chains

fields.name: mlist_head_va
fields.desc: GPU virtual address of first MList chunk intersecting this tile

fields.name: mlist_tail_va
fields.desc: GPU virtual address of active MList chunk being appended

vheap.name: Vertex Heap Table (VHeap Table)
vheap.description: Elastic parameter memory pool managing dynamic expansion and overflow during high scene complexity
vheap.reclaim_policy: Full deallocation or pool recycling upon render pass completion (MsrTileDone)

fender_chinook_fabric_controller.description: Apple G18 Memory Fabric Controller arbitrating traffic between GPU pipelines, MSRF coprocessor, and unified DRAM

GFenderCfg.description: Fender memory controller configuration, fabric routing policies, and bandwidth throttling
features: Priority routing between TA (tiling) and PDM (rasterization) pipelines
Thermal throttling and memory bandwidth allocation
QoS arbitration for realtime display surface refreshes

GM_GIFAF.description: GPU Memory Fabric Interface (GIFAF) interconnect connecting GPU clusters to LPDDR5X UMA

FenderScratchRam.description: On-chip high-speed scratchpad SRAM buffer embedded inside Fender controller
FenderScratchRam.usage: Temporary tile state caching and non-coherent DMA descriptor buffering

DFender_CS.description: Dual-Fender Command Stream serialization and dispatch unit
DFender_CS.operation: Serializes command packets across dual memory channels

DFender_IVDM.description: Dual-Fender Internal Vertex Data Master pipeline routing unit
DFender_IVDM.operation: Routes transformed vertex data directly to MSRF and L2 cache without CPU intervention

mmio_apertures.description: Power Management & Processor Doorbell MMIO region for direct userland command submission
Memory fabric configuration and channel routing aperture
GPU Memory Fabric Interface interconnect registers
